description: The categories a Blue Protocol: Star Resonance chat message can be in. A root is what the first gate (Gate 1) chooses between; its children are what a deeper gate (Gate 1-A) chooses between, and a deeper gate can add a level below them. A category is a lower-case path, 'chat/reaction'. Each description is written to be shown to a classifier next to the others: a bare label is easy to misroute, a described one is not. The example phrases are made up. 'other' is the catch-all and is never trained on.

social.description: Polite formulas between players: greetings, farewells, thanks, apologies, congratulations (おはよう, ありがとう, お疲れ様, よろしくお願いします, おめでとう).

greeting.description: Hello and goodbye: おはよう, こんばんは, お先に失礼します, また明日.

thanks.description: Thanks, apologies and congratulations: ありがとう, ごめんなさい, 乙, おめでとう.

chat.description: Everyday conversation between players that is not about recruiting, trading, a question or the game's mechanics.

casual.description: Ordinary talk: what someone is doing, jokes, opinions, personal remarks, small talk.

reaction.description: Very short emotional reactions or laughter: 草, ww, すごい, ナイス, えぐ, かわいい.

game.description: Talk about how the game works or what to do in it, said as a statement and not as a question: classes, skills, builds, quests, dungeons, bosses, gear, events, the open market, maintenance, bugs.

combat.description: Combat talk: classes, skills, builds, damage, rotations, stats and equipment effects.

progress.description: Progression talk: quests, levels, maps, dungeons, bosses, gear goals, farming, events as something to do.

system.description: The game as a service: maintenance, patches, updates, bugs, lag, servers, login problems.

market.description: Talk about the open market, where players list items for sale and buy what others listed (there is no trade between two players): prices, what is worth listing, what sells, that something was listed or bought, the market tax.

question.description: A player asks for information or help and expects an answer, including what to sell or buy on the open market: どうやって〜？, 〜はどこですか, 教えてください, 何を売ればいい？, 誰か〜わかる人いますか.

game.description: A question about the game: where, how, what, which, how much.

other.description: Any other question, including questions to a person and rhetorical ones.

coordination.description: Real-time coordination while playing together: ready checks, waiting, calling targets or positions, asking for a heal or a revive, gathering, starting a run (準備OK, ちょっと待って, 集合, ボス行きます, 回復お願い).

recruitment.description: A player or a guild is looking for people: members for a party, dungeon, raid or boss run, or members for a guild.

party.description: Looking for members for a party, dungeon, raid or boss run, often with requirements (遺跡1F 29k↑ @T1, 杖@2募集, 火力募集).

guild.description: A guild advertises itself or a player looks for a guild (ギルメン募集, 初心者歓迎, ギルド探してます).

bot.description: Automated messages: system notices, loot or queue announcements, and auto-posting bots (not a person typing).

system.description: Notices produced by the game or a tool: loot, queue pops, timers, status lines.

ad.description: Automated advertisement posts, for example repeated service or link ads.

spam.description: Floods and walls: the same text pasted again and again, long advertisement walls with many IDs, meaningless repetition.

wall.description: A long pasted wall, typically a recruitment or advertisement text with several IDs.

flood.description: Repeated characters or the same short text posted over and over without meaning.

other.description: Does not fit any other category or cannot be read: symbols only, emoticons only, cut-off fragments, a lone character. Never trained on.
